description1.1a: This number determines how long (in ticks) an egg will take to hatch (at minimum).
description1.1b: The default value is 700, which is equivalent to 35 seconds.

description2.2a: This number determines how long (in ticks) an egg will take to hatch (at max).
description2.2b: The default value is 6000, which is equivalent to five minutes.

description3.3a: This number determines how often a mob will drop their spawn egg.
description3.3b: The default number is 0.005, which is 0.5% chance to drop. Higher values means higher chances to drop.
